doc: The playthrough's leg 29_gate_home (tools/playthrough/route.txt, the cartridge's own pad, graded leg by leg against the port by tools/playthrough.py): Truce Canyon (070): up and east along the canyon (the imps on the way: a fight, played by the pilot; Crono, at 1 HP since Yakra, falls and gets up with 1), the exit (31,11) into the gate's clearing (071): the scene ("How do we get home?", Lucca's Gate Key) -- A through it; the gate to 1000 A.D., the Telepod (008): Lucca stays (storyline 27, party 00 01 81) the canyon by `route 29_gate_home "0:2" 31 11 --exit`, the last steps Down + Right into the box
